4d075733c6.caption:
Gunman kills one and wounds four others in Washington

A shooting in Washington, D.C.'s Logan Circle neighborhood left one person dead and four others wounded. Police say the suspect is dead after shooting someone inside a fitness center and barricading himself in a nearby apartment.
